incidents.body:
11:11 Systems engineers have migrated all of the legacy Green Cloud Defense customer communications into our global communications tool.

As of today, 3 September 2026, we have sunset the site: https://status.grncld.net/. All future maintenance and incident notifications will be communicated via the customer portal in 11:11 Systems.

If you have not already opted-in to these future maintenance and incident communications please use the link below to learn how to opt-in to these communications.

How to Opt-in and Subscribe to notifications via the Account App: https://success.1111systems.com/docs/11-11-services-information/service-status-in-the-account-app

If you require any help, please contact your 11:11 Systems Service Manager (available in the Account App home page).
incidents.title: GCD Status Page Transition to Account App
